messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['When you receive this letter. Kindly send me an e-mail signifying your interest including your private Tel/Fax numbers for quick communication.', 'Please open the COMPLAINT REPORT below to view more information on this question and suggest us about your point of view as soon as possible.', 'If this purchasing was made by someone else, and you want to cancel the subscription, click on the link under the sign-up options in this letter, and then change the password on your profile, maybe it was stolen.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "Please review the complaint and share your perspective promptly; confirm your interest by email, or cancel an unauthorized subscription and secure your account."}
